preconditions.description: The input integer n must be between 1 and 1,000,000 inclusive.

postconditions.description: Both strings s and p in the output must have a length of at most 200 characters.
Both strings s and p in the output must consist only of alphabetic characters (a-z and A-Z).
The string p must appear in s as a subsequence exactly n times, where n is the input integer.
